### [2] Zod v4 Changelog / Migration Guide

- **URL:** https://zod.dev/v4/changelog
- **Accessed:** 2026-04-02
- **Tier:** 2 (Official documentation)
- **Data extracted:** Complete list of breaking changes: unified `error` parameter replacing `message`/`invalid_type_error`/`required_error`, ZodError API changes (.format()/.flatten() → z.treeifyError()), string format validators moved to top-level, UUID RFC 9562/4122 strictness, z.coerce input type change, .default() behavior shift, object method deprecations (.strict()/.passthrough()/.merge()), z.nativeEnum() deprecation, .nonempty() type change, z.function() overhaul, z.record() requiring both args, ctx.path removal, internal architecture changes (ZodEffects removed, ZodTransform added)
